name: asrp-verify
description: Validate ASRP records, fingerprints, relationships, and referenced architecture or policy artifacts.
---

# Verify Structure

Run:

```bash
asrp validate structure.json
asrp inspect structure.json
asrp verify structure.json --artifact-root .
```

A valid fingerprint proves local content integrity, not architectural fitness,
owner consent, policy correctness, or execution.
